characters.name: Rex "The Titan" Tolliver
characters.gimmick: Small-town hero with a heart of gold and arms like tree trunks. Never backs down.

characters.name: "Slick" Vic Vega
characters.gimmick: Arrogant Vegas playboy champion in a sequined robe. Cheats, gloats, and never shuts up.
characters.entrance: to a slot-machine jingle and saxophone

characters.name: Johnny Lightning
characters.gimmick: Neon-clad daredevil who lives on the top rope. Fans adore him.

characters.name: Baron von Krank
characters.gimmick: Monocled European aristocrat who considers the fans peasants.

characters.name: Big Earl Mosley
characters.gimmick: 400-pound trucker who loves barbecue and hates bullies.

characters.name: Mad Dog McGraw
characters.gimmick: Unhinged brawler who barks at the crowd and bites opponents.

characters.name: Tommy "Hollywood" Sterling
characters.gimmick: Flashy B-movie star who thinks every match is a screen test.
characters.entrance: under a spotlight to a movie fanfare

characters.name: Sgt. Sam Stryker
characters.gimmick: Drill-sergeant patriot who salutes the crowd and demands discipline.

characters.name: Kid Kaos
characters.gimmick: Skateboarding punk with a mohawk who answers to nobody.
characters.entrance: to a punk riff and a skateboard clatter

characters.name: Brutus Bane
characters.gimmick: Silent masked monster with a mysterious past, led by Sir Reginald.
characters.entrance: as the lights go red and a gong sounds

characters.name: "Cowboy" Clint Harlan
characters.gimmick: Rodeo cowboy and Rex's best friend. Tag partners as The Heartland Express.

characters.name: Roxy Rebel
characters.gimmick: Leather-jacket rock chick with a fearless streak.

characters.name: Lady Viper
characters.gimmick: Venomous women's champion who hisses at opponents.
characters.entrance: to a rattlesnake hiss and a dark bassline

characters.name: Sir Reginald Pemberton
characters.gimmick: Posh, scheming manager with an umbrella and a checkbook. Manages Krank and Bane as The Pemberton Establishment.

characters.name: Debbie Divine
characters.gimmick: Vic Vega's glamorous valet. Loyal to Vega... for now.

characters.name: Lance Holloway
characters.gimmick: Veteran interviewer in a brown suit. Seen it all, still shocked every week.

feuds.reason: Vega stole the world title from Rex with his feet on the ropes.
Mad Dog bit Earl and ate his barbecue.

storySoFar: Slick Vic Vega is the World Champion after cheating Rex Tolliver with his feet on the ropes. Rex wants a rematch. Mad Dog McGraw has been terrorizing Big Earl Mosley. Sir Reginald Pemberton's Establishment is hunting for gold. Lady Viper rules the women's division with an iron fist.
